findings.title: 5 of 8 demo PDFs say 'did not provide a personal statement' while the demo app shows one (and 3 of those PDFs quote it)
findings.location: server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:250 (simple_row has no personal_statement param); client/src/demo/demo_fixtures.gleam (all 8 fixtures carry statements)
findings.evidence: simple_row signature (server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:250-279) has no personal_statement arg -> base_row default None (pdf_prebake.gleam:100). pdftotext report-a-{sara,conor,marta,tom,liam}.pdf each contain 'The applicant did not provide a personal statement.' Client fixtures: a-sara personal_statement='Junior developer at Kite Software, one year in, renting in Clontarf for two years.' (demo_fixtures.gleam:89); a-tom='...Moved home for a year to save a deposit, ready to move back out now.'; a-liam='Delivery driver, six months in current role after a career change.'; a-marta, a-conor likewise. tom/marta/liam PDF Category Notes quote those statements verbatim as HIGH-confidence 'Personal statement' evidence. report-a-sara.pdf Recommended Next Steps: 'Request a personal statement'.
findings.detail: Screen-PDF parity is this round's core bar. A demo prospect reading Sara's on-screen statement then her PDF's 'Request a personal statement' recommendation sees the exact fake-feeling inconsistency the round was funded to remove.
findings.recommended_fix: Thread the five fixture statements through simple_row (or per-row overrides) and re-bake the 8 PDFs; keep the notes' quotes.

findings.title: Screen-PDF flags/positives sync unpinned — reverting demo enrichment to '[]' fails no test
findings.location: client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam (no flags/positives assertions); client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam:212-295; server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam ReportPayload flags/positives
findings.evidence: PR body: 'Screen↔PDF consistency: the on-screen app-detail analyses (demo_store) now carry the same flags/positives arrays as the PDFs.' Grep of client/test + server/test: no test asserts demo flags/positives content.
findings.detail: The claimed deliverable is hand-maintained in two places with no parity pin; the personal-statement drift (B1) is this failure mode already shipped.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a pin asserting demo_store analysis flags/positives non-empty and matching pdf payload labels for all 8 applicants.

findings.title: Liam report prose contradicts its own document count ('only other attachment' vs 1 doc on file)
findings.evidence: documents_for('a-liam') = [base_doc('doc-liam-1','proof_of_income','payslips.pdf')] (pdf_prebake.gleam:683-685) — one document. Note text: 'One document on file — payslips — with the landlord reference as the only other attachment'; evidence item in same note: 'Documents provided: 1 of 5 categories'.
findings.detail: The landlord reference is a form field (Karen Whitmore), not an attachment; the sentence invents a second document the same report says doesn't exist.
findings.recommended_fix: Rephrase to 'One document on file — payslips; the landlord reference is a form entry, not an uploaded document.'

findings.title: Client competition-ranks port unpinned for ties/None tail (server side fully tested)
findings.evidence: Port byte-identical to server/src/vacancy/application_list_handler.gleam:231-271 (diffed). Server tests: leaderboard_test.gleam competition_ranks_shared_for_ties_test / _unscored_tail_test / _offset_start_test. Client tests use 8 distinct scores only.
findings.detail: A future edit that diverges the client copy from the server algorithm would pass the client suite.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the three server rank tests against demo_store.competition_ranks, or move the function to a shared module.

findings.title: Banner-survival pin is one-sided — consent banner's own z-index/anchor unasserted
findings.evidence: Pin asserts toast literal 'fixed top-20 right-4 z-[2147483001]'. consent.js:393: 'position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483000;' — no test reads consent.js.
findings.detail: If consent.js's banner z regresses above the toast literal, no test notices; the relationship lives only in a comment.
findings.recommended_fix: A test that reads priv/static/consent.js and asserts 2147483000 + bottom anchoring.

findings.title: docs_processed pin is param-echo; no pin that documents_for mirrors the client fixtures' lists
findings.evidence: extras_for(app_id, docs) fed list.length(pdf_prebake.documents_for(app_id)) then asserts extras.docs_processed equals the same expression. Real bake calls extras_for(id, list.length(documents_for(id))) (pdf_prebake.gleam:604-606) — wiring matches, but server documents_for vs client demo_store.documents_for is hand-synced, unpinned.
findings.detail: Param-echo pins the JSON contract only; document-list drift between screen and PDF would pass.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin per-applicant document counts/categories against the client fixture lists.

findings.title: extras_for fallback silently bakes a thin report for any unlisted applicant id
findings.evidence: _ -> fallback_parts(); fallback_parts: insight='This is synthetic demo data...', notes: json.object([]), recs: []. Pin test iterates the same hardcoded 8 ids as payloads().
findings.detail: A future 9th fixture applicant would ship a 3-page stub with no test failure — the exact scanty-report regression this round fixed.
findings.recommended_fix: Make the fallback panic-in-test or assert fallback is unreachable for every payloads() id.

findings.title: pub widenings with no external callers (pdf_prebake.payloads, demo_store.competition_ranks)
findings.evidence: Diff widens fn payloads() -> pub fn payloads(); no caller of pdf_prebake.payloads outside the module (test uses documents_for only). demo_store.competition_ranks pub, called unqualified internally; no external caller.
findings.detail: Dead public surface invites drift; Gleam warns on unused only for private fns.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep documents_for pub (test-consumed); revert payloads/competition_ranks to fn, or consume them in the tests.

findings.title: Compare Top 3 click-through unpinned (button render pinned; handler pre-existing, untested for this path)
findings.evidence: grep UserClickedCompareTop3 client/test -> no hits. Render proof asserts compare-top-3-btn on page; demo_comparison_arm_pins_loading_test covers AppRequestedComparisonDetails loading arm.
findings.detail: A regression in the shared handler (route push / top_ids selection) would pass the suite; PR claims in-browser verification only.

findings.title: Snapshot-row fixes unpinned (phone, tenure, Declan DM Plumbing income source, Aoife/Marta income-source removals)
findings.evidence: PR body lists these fixes; no test asserts phone/tenure Some() or income_sources content; reverting them to None fails nothing.
findings.detail: Regression risk on a claimed fix; cheap to pin via row snapshots.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert simple_row/base_row outputs for one strong and one weak applicant.

findings.title: Committed PDFs have no freshness pin against prebake output — a stale bake ships silently
findings.location: server/priv/static/demo/report-*.pdf; regen is manual (gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake)
findings.evidence: report_download_test pins filename mapping only; nothing ties committed bytes to current payload code.
findings.detail: B1's fix requires a re-bake; without a freshness signal the next payload edit can ship stale PDFs again.
findings.recommended_fix: Record a manifest (sha256 per PDF) generated by the bake, and assert committed files match it in the server suite.
